title: What actually broke when I tried to fine-tune on web-scraped data and what fixed it [D]
summary: Fine tuning on self collected web data felt straightforward until it wasn’t. Here’s what actually caused problems: Boilerplate contamination was the silent killer. Navigation menus, cookie banners, and footer text were leaking into training examples. The model started generating
